parsed.scene_description: The image shows the interior of a supermarket aisle with shelves stocked with various snacks and drinks. The shelves are arranged in rows and the floor is tiled. On the left side of the image, there are shelves filled with packets of snacks, while on the right side, there is a display case with more snacks. In the center of the aisle, a person is standing in front of a counter with a sign that reads "Bubble" in Chinese characters. Above the counter, two hot air balloons are hanging from the ceiling. The overall atmosphere of the store is bright and colorful.
